questions.stem: In the equation x² + kx + 36 = 0, k is a constant. The equation has two real solutions, and one solution is 4 times the other. What is the positive value of k ?

questions.subskill: Subtracting reciprocal-shaped fractions
questions.stem: For x > 0, which of the following is equivalent to (x + 1)/x − x/(x + 1) ?

questions.subskill: Parabolic arch from two widths
questions.stem: The opening of an arch has the shape of a parabola. The opening is 40 meters wide at ground level and 30 meters wide at a height of 7 meters. What is the height of the arch at its highest point, in meters?

questions.subskill: Rational equation with a single valid solution
questions.stem: Which of the following describes all solutions to the equation (x − 1)/(x + 1) = (x + 1)/(x − 1) ?

questions.subskill: Two ways a rational equation has no solution
questions.stem: In the equation 3/(x − 1) = k/(x + 2), k is a constant. For which of the following values of k does the equation have no solution?

questions.subskill: Combining fractions with opposite denominators
questions.stem: For x ≠ 3, which of the following is equivalent to 2x/(x − 3) + 6/(3 − x) ?

questions.subskill: The one solution shared by a family of quadratics
questions.stem: In the equation x² + (k − 2)x + k − 3 = 0, k is a constant. The equation has exactly one real solution. What is that solution?

questions.subskill: Similar triangles with a perpendicular from the hypotenuse
questions.stem: In right triangle ABC, angle C is the right angle, AC = 6, and BC = 8. Point D lies on hypotenuse AB so that AD = 4. The line through D perpendicular to AB intersects side BC at point E. What is the length of DE ?

questions.subskill: Square inscribed on a side of a triangle
questions.stem: An acute triangle has a side of length 15, and the height to that side is 10. A square is drawn inside the triangle so that one side of the square lies on the side of length 15 and the other two vertices of the square lie on the other two sides of the triangle. What is the side length of the square?

questions.subskill: Area from two special right triangles
questions.stem: In triangle ABC, the measure of angle B is 45°, the measure of angle C is 30°, and AB = 6√2. What is the area of triangle ABC ?

questions.subskill: Areas of similar triangles from a sum
questions.stem: Two triangles are similar, and the ratio of their perimeters is 2 : 3. The sum of their areas is 52 square units. What is the area of the smaller triangle, in square units?

questions.subskill: Angle from a cosine value and a sign
questions.stem: If 0 ≤ θ < 2π, cos θ = −1/2, and sin θ < 0, what is the value of θ ?

questions.subskill: Quarter turn on the unit circle
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, the point P(−0.6, 0.8) lies on the unit circle, and θ is the radian measure of the angle from the positive x-axis to ray OP, where O is the origin. Point Q lies on the unit circle so that the angle from the positive x-axis to ray OQ measures θ + π/2 radians. What are the coordinates of Q ?

questions.subskill: Using a cofunction relation to find a right angle
questions.stem: In triangle ABC, angles A and B are acute and sin A = cos B. If AB = 10 and BC = 6, what is the area of triangle ABC ?

questions.subskill: Converting both cofunctions
questions.stem: For an acute angle with measure x°, cos x° = 0.28. What is the value of sin(90 − x)° + cos(90 − x)° ?

questions.subskill: Circle with a shared center through the origin
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, a circle has the same center as the circle x² + y² + 6x − 4y = 3 and passes through the origin. Which of the following is an equation of this circle?

questions.subskill: Volume of a cylinder with hemispherical ends
questions.stem: A storage tank is a right circular cylinder with a hemisphere attached to each end. The tank has a radius of 3 meters, and its total length, from the tip of one hemisphere to the tip of the other, is 20 meters. What is the volume of the tank, in cubic meters?

questions.subskill: Surface area after cutting a notch from an edge
questions.stem: A solid cube has edges of length 5 centimeters. A cube with edges of length 2 centimeters is cut out from the middle of one edge of the large cube, so that two faces of the small cube lie on two faces of the large cube. What is the total surface area of the remaining solid, in square centimeters?

questions.subskill: Perpendicular lines from their intercepts
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, lines ℓ and m are perpendicular and intersect at a point on the positive x-axis. The y-intercept of line ℓ is 8, and the y-intercept of line m is −2. What is the x-coordinate of the point where ℓ and m intersect?

questions.subskill: Counting lines through a point with integer intercepts
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, a line passes through the point (3, 4), and both its x-intercept and its y-intercept are positive integers. How many such lines are there?

questions.subskill: No-solution system with a parameter in two coefficients
questions.stem:
In the system of equations below, k is a constant.
kx + 2y = 6
3x + (k + 1)y = 9
For which value(s) of k does the system have no solution?

questions.subskill: A negative solution read as a past time
questions.stem: At the same moment, tree A was measured at 3.0 meters tall and tree B at 2.4 meters tall. Tree A grows 0.4 meter per year and tree B grows 0.3 meter per year, and both have grown at these constant rates since they were planted. According to these models, which statement is true?

choices.A: The trees will have the same height 6 years after the measurements, when each will be 5.4 meters tall.
choices.B: The trees had the same height 6 years before the measurements, when each was 0.6 meter tall.
choices.C: The trees have never had the same height, because tree A is taller and grows faster.
choices.D: The trees had the same height 8 years before the measurements, when each was 0 meters tall.

questions.subskill: Point inside a triangle bounded by lines
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, a triangle is bounded by the x-axis, the line y = x, and the line y = −2x + 12. Which of the following points lies inside the triangle?

questions.subskill: Unit price from the difference of two bundles
questions.stem: A store sells the same granola bars in boxes of 8 and boxes of 12, and the price per bar is the same for both boxes. A box of 12 costs $1.20 more than a box of 8. What is the price, in dollars, of a box of 8 bars?

questions.subskill: Counting integer solutions of a two-variable inequality
questions.stem: A delivery drone can carry a total of at most 12 kilograms of parcels on each flight. Small parcels weigh 2 kilograms each, and large parcels weigh 3 kilograms each. Every flight carries at least 1 small parcel and at least 1 large parcel. How many different combinations of numbers of small and large parcels can a flight carry?

questions.subskill: Three unknowns from cyclic pair sums
questions.stem: Three suitcases are weighed in pairs at an airport. Suitcases A and B together weigh 41 kilograms, suitcases B and C together weigh 47 kilograms, and suitcases A and C together weigh 50 kilograms. What is the weight, in kilograms, of the heaviest suitcase?

questions.subskill: Intercept of a linear model fit to later data
questions.stem: For the first 5 years after it was bought, the resale value of a laptop decreased linearly. One year after purchase, its value was 80% of the purchase price. Three years after purchase, its value was 62.5% of its value one year after purchase. If the linear model for years 1 through 5 is extended back to t = 0, where t is the number of years after purchase, the model's value at t = 0 is what percent of the purchase price?

questions.subskill: A line and its reflection across y = x
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, line ℓ has equation y = 3x − 6. Line m is the reflection of line ℓ across the line y = x. What is the x-coordinate of the point where lines ℓ and m intersect?

questions.subskill: Intercept interval for an intersection in a given quadrant
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, line ℓ has equation y = 2x + 1. Line m is perpendicular to line ℓ and has y-intercept b, where b is a constant. The lines intersect at a point in Quadrant II. Which of the following could be the value of b ?

questions.subskill: Parameter that makes two linear functions commute
questions.stem: The linear functions f and g are defined by f(x) = 2x + 3 and g(x) = ax + 1, where a is a constant. If f(g(x)) = g(f(x)) for all values of x, what is the value of a ?

questions.subskill: Inequality with a used amount and a unit conversion
questions.stem: A phone has 128 gigabytes (GB) of storage, of which 22.5 GB is already used. A user wants to store x photos, each 4 megabytes (MB), and y minutes of video, each minute 120 MB, without exceeding the remaining storage. If 1 GB = 1,000 MB, which inequality represents this situation?

questions.subskill: Perpendicular line through a point found by scaling
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, line ℓ passes through the origin and the point (4, 3). Point P lies on line ℓ in Quadrant I, and the distance from the origin to P is 10. Line n passes through P and is perpendicular to line ℓ. Which of the following is an equation of line n ?

questions.subskill: Quadrants reached by a system of linear inequalities
questions.stem:
In the xy-plane, which quadrants contain at least one solution (x, y) of the system of inequalities below?
y > 2x + 3
y < −x − 1

questions.subskill: Change in x for a given change in predicted y
questions.stem: A scatterplot shows the number of hours of practice x and the number of errors y for each of 20 typists. The line of best fit is y = −1.8x + 27. According to the line of best fit, how many more hours of practice are associated with 9 fewer predicted errors?

questions.subskill: Percent change applied to a new base
questions.stem: A bank lowered the interest rate on a savings account from 6.0% to 4.5%. Later, the bank lowered the rate again by the same percent as the first decrease. What was the interest rate after the second decrease?

questions.subskill: Converting each ingredient with its own rate
questions.stem: A baker's recipe calls for 500 grams of flour and 300 grams of sugar. The baker has only a 1-cup measure. One cup of flour has a mass of 125 grams, and one cup of sugar has a mass of 200 grams. How many cups of flour and sugar together does the recipe call for?

questions.subskill: Comparing two conditional rates as a ratio
questions.stem: A college surveyed 300 students. Of the 120 students who live on campus, 24 own a car. Of the 180 students who live off campus, 72 own a car. Based on these data, a student who lives off campus is how many times as likely to own a car as a student who lives on campus?

questions.subskill: Count rate from a speed and a spacing
questions.stem: On a packaging line, a conveyor belt moves at a constant 0.4 meter per second, and boxes are placed on the belt one after another, 25 centimeters apart from front edge to front edge. At this rate, how many boxes reach the end of the belt in 1 hour?

questions.subskill: Two-way table from equal conditional probabilities
questions.stem: A school surveyed 150 juniors and seniors about whether they belong to the robotics club. Of the juniors, 24 belong to the club. Of the seniors, 36 do not belong to the club. If a student is selected at random, the probability that the student is a junior given that the student belongs to the club is equal to the probability that the student belongs to the club given that the student is a junior. How many seniors belong to the club?

questions.subskill: Least whole from two percent conditions
questions.stem: A hiking club reports that exactly 45% of its members are women and that exactly 40% of the women in the club are under 30 years old. What is the least possible number of members in the club?

questions.subskill: Percent change in a tax-included price
questions.stem: In a country, the price of every item in a shop includes a value-added tax (VAT) equal to 20% of the item's pre-tax price. The VAT rate is lowered to 14%, and pre-tax prices do not change. By what percent do the shop prices, including VAT, decrease?

questions.subskill: Mean equals median with an unknown in any position
questions.stem: A data set consists of the six numbers 3, 8, 12, x, 15, and 20. The mean of the data set is equal to its median. What is the sum of all possible values of x ?

questions.subskill: Conditional probability with an "at least" condition
questions.stem: In a survey of households, 35% had no pets, 30% had exactly 1 pet, 20% had exactly 2 pets, and 15% had 3 or more pets. If a household that has at least 1 pet is selected at random, what is the probability that it has at least 2 pets?

questions.subskill: Effect of a high point at the left end on a fitted line
questions.stem: A scatterplot shows 12 data points with x-values 1, 2, 3, …, 12. Eleven of the points lie very close to the line y = 3x + 5, but the point with x = 1 is (1, 30), far above that line. A line of best fit is found for all 12 points. If the point (1, 30) is removed and a new line of best fit is found for the other 11 points, how will the new line compare with the original line?

questions.subskill: Range and standard deviation ranking in opposite orders
questions.stem: Data set A consists of 8 values: four 2s and four 8s. Data set B consists of 8 values: one 0, six 5s, and one 10. Both data sets have a mean of 5. Which statement is true?

choices.A: Data set A has the greater range and the greater standard deviation.
choices.B: Data set B has the greater range and the greater standard deviation.
choices.C: Data set B has the greater range, but data set A has the greater standard deviation.
choices.D: The data sets have the same standard deviation because they have the same mean.

questions.subskill: Symmetry carried through a shift and a compression
questions.stem: The quadratic function f satisfies f(x) = f(4 − x) for all values of x. The function g is defined by g(x) = f(2x − 6). For all values of x, g(x) = g(k − x), where k is a constant. What is the value of k ?

questions.subskill: Extraneous root rejected after substitution
questions.stem: What is the sum of all real solutions to the equation x² − 4x = 2√(x² − 4x + 8) ?

questions.subskill: Difference of cubes in a rational expression
questions.stem: For x ≠ 2 and x ≠ −2, which of the following is equivalent to (x³ − 8)/(x² − 4) − (x² + 4)/(x + 2) ?

questions.subskill: Difference of squares from a sum and a difference
questions.stem: If x > 0 and x − 1/x = 3, what is the value of x² − 1/x² ?

questions.subskill: Revenue model built from price increases
questions.stem: A theater sells 360 tickets per show at a price of $12 per ticket. For each $1 increase in the ticket price, it sells 15 fewer tickets per show. Assuming this relationship continues, what ticket price, in dollars, gives the greatest revenue per show?

questions.subskill: Function of a reciprocal input
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = (x + 1)/(x − 1). For x ≠ 0, x ≠ 1, and x ≠ −1, which of the following is equal to f(1/x) ?

questions.subskill: Line through a known point meeting a circle again
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, the line y = mx + 5, where m is a constant, intersects the circle x² + y² = 25 at the point (0, 5) and at one other point, whose x-coordinate is 4. What is the sum of all possible values of m ?

questions.subskill: Inequality on a composition
questions.stem: The functions f and g are defined by f(x) = x² − 4x and g(x) = x + 2. Which of the following describes all values of x for which f(g(x)) < 0 ?

questions.subskill: Inscribed angles on the same arc
questions.stem: Points A, B, C, and D lie on a circle in that order, and chords AC and BD intersect at point E. The measure of angle ABD is 50°, and the measure of angle AEB is 75°. What is the measure of angle BDC ?

questions.subskill: Revolutions per minute to radians per second
questions.stem: A turntable rotates at a constant rate of 45 revolutions per minute. What is the turntable's rate of rotation, in radians per second?

questions.subskill: Surface area after finding a missing height
questions.stem: A closed right rectangular prism has a volume of 360 cubic centimeters, and its base is a rectangle that is 8 centimeters by 9 centimeters. What is the total surface area of the prism, in square centimeters?

questions.subskill: Equal angles inside a right triangle
questions.stem: In right triangle ABC, angle C is the right angle, AC = 6, and BC = 12. Point D lies on side BC so that angle CAD has the same measure as angle ABC. What is the length of BD ?

questions.subskill: Slope after swapping the axes
questions.stem: A scientist models the mass m, in grams, of a growing crystal d days after it begins forming with the equation m = 0.4d + 12. A student graphs the same relationship with m on the horizontal axis and d on the vertical axis. What is the slope of the student's graph, and what does it represent?

choices.A: 0.4; the crystal gains 0.4 gram per day.
choices.B: 2.5; the crystal takes 2.5 days to gain each gram.
choices.C: 2.5; the crystal gains 2.5 grams per day.
choices.D: 0.4; the crystal takes 0.4 day to gain each gram.

questions.subskill: Remainder from polynomial division
questions.stem: For x ≠ −2, the expression (2x² + 7x + 9)/(x + 2) is equivalent to 2x + 3 + k/(x + 2), where k is a constant. What is the value of k ?

questions.subskill: Scope of a causal conclusion from two active treatments
questions.stem: At a clinic, 120 adult volunteers with seasonal allergies were randomly assigned to take either drug A or drug B for one month. Patients who took drug A reported fewer days with symptoms, on average, than patients who took drug B, and the difference was too large to be explained by chance alone. Which conclusion is best supported?

choices.A: For patients like those in the study, taking drug A likely causes fewer symptom days than taking drug B does.
choices.B: For patients like those in the study, taking drug A likely causes fewer symptom days than taking no medication does.
choices.C: No conclusion about cause can be drawn, because the study did not include a placebo group.
choices.D: Drug A likely causes fewer symptom days than drug B does for all adults with seasonal allergies.

questions.subskill: Percent increase turned into a growth factor
questions.stem: The population of a species of beetle in a field is modeled by P(t) = 1,000 · 2^(t/5), where t is the number of years since 2020. How many years after 2020 is the population 700% greater than it was in 2020?

questions.subskill: Exponential model from unevenly spaced inputs
questions.stem:
The table shows three values of a function P.
t: 0, 2, 5
P(t): 400, 484, 644.204
Which of the following could define P ?

questions.subskill: Translation read from a completed square
questions.stem: Which of the following describes a translation that maps the graph of y = x² onto the graph of y = x² + 6x + 4 in the xy-plane?

questions.subskill: Second intersection of a line and a parabola
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, a line passes through the point (0, −1) and intersects the parabola y = x² at two points. One of these points is (4, 16). What is the x-coordinate of the other point?

questions.subskill: Constants from a quadratic factor of a quartic
questions.stem: The polynomial p is defined by p(x) = x⁴ + ax² + b, where a and b are constants. If x² − 3x + 2 is a factor of p(x), what is the value of b ?

questions.subskill: Composition that looks like an inverse
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = x² − 4, and the function g is defined by g(x) = √(x + 4) for x ≥ −4. For which values of x is g(f(x)) = x ?

questions.subskill: Chord between two tangent points
questions.stem: From point P outside a circle with center O and radius 6, segments PA and PB are tangent to the circle at points A and B, and PA = 8. What is the length of chord AB ?

questions.subskill: Crossing height of two wires between poles
questions.stem: Two vertical poles stand on level ground 15 meters apart. One pole is 6 meters tall, and the other is 9 meters tall. A straight wire runs from the top of each pole to the bottom of the other pole. How many meters above the ground do the two wires cross?

questions.subskill: Inscribed angle, central angle, and tangent
questions.stem: Segment AB is a diameter of a circle with center O, and point C lies on the circle. The measure of angle CAB is 25°. The line tangent to the circle at C intersects line AB at point D, which lies beyond B. What is the measure, in degrees, of angle ADC ?

questions.subskill: Cylinder inscribed in a sphere
questions.stem: A right circular cylinder with a height of 8 centimeters is inscribed in a sphere with a radius of 5 centimeters, so that the circular edges of both bases of the cylinder lie on the sphere. What is the volume, in cubic centimeters, of the cylinder?

questions.subskill: Complementary-angle identity in context
questions.stem: A kite is flying at the end of a straight, taut string 50 meters long, held at ground level. The string makes an angle of x° with the level ground, and cos(90 − x)° = 0.6. How many meters above the ground is the kite?

questions.subskill: Two special right triangles sharing a side
questions.stem: In quadrilateral ABCD, angle ABC and angle ACD are right angles. The measure of angle BAC is 30°, the measure of angle CAD is 45°, and AB = 6. What is the length of AD ?

questions.subskill: Equilateral triangle inside a square
questions.stem: Square ABCD has its vertices in counterclockwise order. Point P lies inside the square so that triangle PAB is equilateral. What is the measure, in degrees, of angle PDC ?

questions.subskill: Bisectors of same-side interior angles
questions.stem: Parallel lines ℓ and m are cut by a transversal t at point A on ℓ and point B on m. Point P lies between ℓ and m, on one side of t. On that side, the angle at A between ray AB and line ℓ measures 64°. Ray AP bisects that angle, and ray BP bisects the angle at B between ray BA and line m on the same side. What is the measure, in degrees, of angle APB ?

questions.subskill: Symmetric combination from a two-equation system
questions.stem: Printers A and B each print pages at their own constant rate. On Monday, printer A ran for 3 minutes and printer B ran for 5 minutes, and together they printed 410 pages. On Tuesday, printer A ran for 5 minutes and printer B ran for 3 minutes, and together they printed 390 pages. How many pages will the two printers print in all if both run for 10 minutes?

questions.subskill: Two translations that give the same line
questions.stem: The function f is linear. In the xy-plane, the graph of y = f(x) + 3 is the same line as the graph of y = f(x + 2). What is the slope of the graph of y = f(x) ?

questions.subskill: Bounded scores with a required total
questions.stem: Ana's mean score on her first 4 tests was 80. She will take 2 more tests, and each test is scored from 0 to 100. If the mean of all 6 of her test scores is to be at least 85, what is the least possible score she could earn on the lower-scoring of the 2 remaining tests?

questions.subskill: Compound inequality with a negative coefficient
questions.stem: Which of the following describes all solutions of the inequality −7 ≤ 3 − 2x < 7 ?

choices.A: There is no value of x that satisfies the inequality.

questions.subskill: Equation with fractions and a leftover amount
questions.stem: Each batch of a muffin recipe uses 2/3 cup of sugar. Lena started with 5 cups of sugar. After she made some batches, she had 1/3 cup of sugar left. How many batches did she make?

questions.subskill: Finding the first error in a solution
questions.stem:
A student solved the equation 4 − 2(x − 3) = 10 as follows.
Step 1: 4 − 2x − 6 = 10
Step 2: −2x − 2 = 10
Step 3: −2x = 12
Step 4: x = −6
In which step did the student first make an error?

questions.subskill: Line from an area and a sign condition
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, a line with a negative slope passes through the point (−3, 0). The line and the two coordinate axes form a triangle with an area of 12. What is the slope of the line?

questions.subskill: Recovering a constant from a miscopied equation
questions.stem: In the equation 7x − 12 = 3x + k, k is a constant. A student copied the equation incorrectly as x − 12 = 3x + k, leaving out the 7, and correctly found that the solution of the copied equation is x = −5. What is the solution of the original equation?

questions.subskill: Moving an overlap between two bases
questions.stem: At a school, 30% of the students are in the band. Of the students in the band, 40% are also in the choir, and these students make up 25% of the students in the choir. What percent of the students at the school are in the choir?

questions.subskill: Guaranteed counts from five-number summaries
questions.stem:
The scores of two classes on the same test are summarized below.
Class A (40 students): minimum 55, first quartile 68, median 75, third quartile 84, maximum 98
Class B (20 students): minimum 60, first quartile 72, median 80, third quartile 86, maximum 95
Which of the following must be true?

choices.A: The mean score of class B is greater than the mean score of class A.
choices.B: More students in class B than in class A scored 86 or higher.
choices.C: More students in class A than in class B scored 80 or higher.
choices.D: More students in class A than in class B scored 75 or lower.

questions.subskill: Probability for a person from a household table
questions.stem: In a survey of all the households in a town, 25% of the households had 1 person, 35% had 2 people, 20% had 3 people, 15% had 4 people, and 5% had 5 people. No household had more than 5 people. If one person who lives in these households is chosen at random, what is the probability that the person lives in a household of 4 or more people?

questions.subskill: Choosing a confounding variable
questions.stem: Researchers selected 30 hospitals at random from all the hospitals in a state. They found that hospitals with more intensive care unit (ICU) beds tended to have higher death rates, measured as deaths per 100 patients. Which of the following, if true, gives the best explanation for this association other than that having more ICU beds causes more deaths?

choices.A: The 30 hospitals were selected at random from all the hospitals in the state.
choices.B: Hospitals with more ICU beds tend to receive the most seriously ill patients from other hospitals.
choices.C: A few hospitals with few ICU beds had higher death rates than some hospitals with many ICU beds.
choices.D: Hospitals with more ICU beds also treat more patients in all.

questions.subskill: Two successive dilutions
questions.stem: A stock solution is 30% dye by volume. A technician mixes 1 milliliter of the stock solution with 9 milliliters of water. Then the technician mixes 1 milliliter of this mixture with 4 milliliters of water. What percent of the final mixture, by volume, is dye? (Disregard the % sign when entering your answer. For example, if your answer is 42.1%, enter 42.1)

questions.subskill: Percent-of-capacity change from net counts
questions.stem: A parking garage was 80% full. Then 30 cars left the garage and 12 cars entered, and the garage was 74% full. How many parking spaces does the garage have?

questions.subskill: Moving point and a strict linear inequality
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, line ℓ passes through the points (0, −2) and (3, 4). The solutions of an inequality are all the points that lie strictly below line ℓ. For which values of c is the point (c, c) a solution of the inequality?

questions.subskill: Linear function that swaps two values
questions.stem: For the linear function f, f(a) = b and f(b) = a, where a and b are constants and a ≠ b. Which of the following must be true?

choices.C: The slope of the graph of f is 1.

questions.subskill: Chain of fractions ending in an equation
questions.stem: A tour group set out from a museum entrance. After the first exhibit, half of the people in the group left. After the second exhibit, 1/3 of the people still in the group left. Then 12 people joined the group, and the group had 8 fewer people than it had at the start. How many people were in the group at the start?

questions.subskill: Equation that reduces to a false statement
questions.stem: Which of the following describes the values of x for which the mean of 2x + 1, 3x − 4, and x + 9 is equal to 2x + 3 ?

choices.A: There are no such values of x.

questions.subskill: Changing one parameter of a linear model
questions.stem: A box of marbles has a total weight of W grams, where W = 18n + 240 and n is the number of marbles in the box. A second box of the same kind is filled with glass marbles, each of which weighs 1.5 times as much as a marble in the first box. Which equation gives the total weight W, in grams, of the second box when it holds n glass marbles?

questions.subskill: Estimates from samples drawn at different rates
questions.stem: A school has 600 underclassmen and 400 upperclassmen. To estimate how many students would join a new club, the school surveyed a random sample of 60 underclassmen and a separate random sample of 80 upperclassmen. Of the students surveyed, 18 underclassmen and 32 upperclassmen said they would join. Based on these samples, what is the best estimate of the number of students at the school who would join the club?

questions.subskill: Repeated stops in a production schedule
questions.stem: A bottling machine fills 40 bottles per minute while it runs. It runs for 10 minutes, stops for 2 minutes, runs for 10 minutes, stops for 2 minutes, and continues in this pattern. If the machine starts running at time 0, how many minutes after it starts will it have filled 1,800 bottles?

questions.subskill: Probability from an inequality and a parity condition
questions.stem: An integer n is chosen at random from the integers 1 through 50, inclusive. What is the probability that 3n + 4 is both greater than 110 and even?

questions.subskill: Restoring a ratio when one ingredient is in excess
questions.stem: A recipe uses flour, sugar, and butter in the ratio 5 : 2 : 3 by weight. A baker making a batch with 500 grams of flour and 300 grams of butter accidentally added 300 grams of sugar instead of 200 grams. To restore the ratio 5 : 2 : 3 without removing any sugar, the baker will add only more flour and more butter. How many grams of flour and butter combined must be added?

questions.subskill: Percent tolerance of an unknown base
questions.stem: A bathroom scale's reading is always within 2% of the true weight of the person on it; that is, the reading differs from the true weight by at most 2% of the true weight. A person's reading is 49.0 kilograms. Which of the following gives all possible values of the person's true weight w, in kilograms, rounded to the nearest hundredth?

questions.subskill: Chained percent comparisons with changing bases
questions.stem: Quantity A is 25% greater than quantity B, and quantity B is 30% less than quantity C. Quantity C is approximately what percent greater than quantity A?

questions.subskill: Testing tables for proportionality
questions.stem: In which of the following tables is y proportional to x ?

questions.subskill: Average rate of change with an unknown endpoint
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = x² − 4x. The average rate of change of f from x = 1 to x = k, where k ≠ 1, is 5. What is the value of k ?

questions.subskill: Rational inequality on a stated domain
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = 12/(x − 2) + 3. Which of the following describes all values of x greater than 2 for which f(x) > 5 ?

questions.subskill: Intersection of a vertical and a horizontal shift
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = x². In the xy-plane, the graphs of y = f(x) + 3 and y = f(x + 3) intersect at exactly one point. What is the x-coordinate of that point?

questions.subskill: Matching the remaining coefficient after cancellation
questions.stem: For all values of x, (x + k)(x − 3) − (x − k)(x + 3) = 10x, where k is a constant. What is the value of k ?

questions.subskill: Vertex constrained to a line
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, the vertex of the graph of y = x² − 8x + c, where c is a constant, lies on the line y = x. What is the value of c ?

questions.subskill: Sum of squares of the solutions
questions.stem: The solutions to the equation x² − 7x + 5 = 0 are a and b. What is the value of a² + b² ?

questions.subskill: Trig ratio applied through an altitude
questions.stem: In right triangle ABC, angle C is the right angle and cos A = 5/13. The altitude from C to hypotenuse AB has length 60. What is the length of AB ?

questions.subskill: Chain of isosceles triangles
questions.stem: In triangle ABC, AB = AC. Point D lies on side AC so that AD = BD = BC. What is the measure, in degrees, of angle BAC ?

questions.subskill: Coordinates from a radian measure on a circle
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, point P lies on the circle with radius 4 centered at the origin O. The angle from the positive x-axis to ray OP measures 5π/6 radians, counterclockwise. What are the coordinates of P ?

questions.subskill: Base of an isosceles triangle in a circle
questions.stem: Triangle ABC is inscribed in a circle with radius 5, and AB = AC = 8. What is the length of BC ?

questions.subskill: Similar triangles from a reflection
questions.stem: A small mirror lies flat on level ground 30 meters from the base of a building. A person whose eyes are 1.6 meters above the ground stands 2 meters from the mirror, on the line through the mirror and the base of the building, and sees the top of the building reflected in the mirror. Light reflects off the mirror so that the angle between the incoming ray and the ground equals the angle between the reflected ray and the ground. What is the height of the building, in meters?

questions.subskill: Prism volume after finding a triangle height
questions.stem: A tent is shaped like a triangular prism that is 3 meters long. Its front face is an isosceles triangle with two sides of length 2.5 meters and a base of length 4 meters on the ground. What is the volume of the space inside the tent, in cubic meters?

questions.subskill: Rational equation from a round trip
questions.stem: Ana drove 120 miles to a city at a constant speed. She returned home along the same route at a constant speed that was 20 miles per hour faster. Her total driving time for the round trip was 5 hours. What was her speed, in miles per hour, on the trip to the city?

questions.subskill: Expanding a binomial cube
questions.stem: Which of the following is equivalent to (x + 2)³ − x³ ?

questions.subskill: Rational equation whose numerator collapses
questions.stem: What is the positive solution to the equation 1/(x − 1) − 1/(x + 1) = 1/12 ?

questions.subskill: Constant of a quadratic from a difference of outputs
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = kx², where k is a constant. If f(3) − f(1) = 32, what is the value of f(5) ?

questions.subskill: Intercept count after a translation
questions.stem: The graph of the quadratic function f in the xy-plane is a parabola that opens upward and has its vertex at (2, −5). How many x-intercepts does the graph of y = f(x − 3) + 5 have?

choices.D: It cannot be determined from the given information.

questions.subskill: Signs of exponential parameters from outputs
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = a · bˣ, where a and b are constants, b > 0, and b ≠ 1. If f(1) > 0 and f(2) < f(1), which of the following must be true?

questions.subskill: Water depth after turning a box
questions.stem: A closed box shaped like a right rectangular prism has inside dimensions of 10 centimeters by 20 centimeters by 30 centimeters. The box rests on its 10-centimeter-by-20-centimeter face and contains water 6 centimeters deep. The box is turned so that it rests on its 20-centimeter-by-30-centimeter face. What is the depth of the water, in centimeters, now?

questions.subskill: Parallelogram between two similar triangles
questions.stem: In triangle ABC, point D lies on side AB so that AD : DB = 2 : 3. Point E lies on side AC so that DE is parallel to BC, and point F lies on side BC so that EF is parallel to AB. The area of parallelogram DBFE is what fraction of the area of triangle ABC ?

questions.subskill: Segment endpoints from a midpoint on the axes
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, point A lies on the x-axis, point B lies on the y-axis, and the midpoint of segment AB is (3, 4). What is the length of AB ?

questions.subskill: Slope when the y-variable is a percent
questions.stem: A scatterplot shows the percent y of households in a region that had a landline telephone x years after 2005, and the line of best fit is y = −2.5x + 92. Which is the best interpretation of −2.5 in this context?

choices.A: Each year, the predicted percent decreases by 2.5% of the previous year's predicted percent.
choices.B: Each year, the predicted number of households with a landline decreases by 2.5.
choices.C: Each year, the predicted percent decreases by 2.5 percentage points.
choices.D: It takes 2.5 years for the predicted percent to decrease by 1 percentage point.

questions.subskill: Which added fact determines a system
questions.stem: A store sold x shirts at $15 each and y hats at $10 each, for a total of $900, so 15x + 10y = 900. Which of the following additional facts, by itself, is enough to determine the values of x and y ?

choices.A: Folding each shirt took 2 minutes and folding each hat took 3 minutes, 170 minutes in all.
choices.B: Folding each shirt took 3 minutes and folding each hat took 2 minutes, 180 minutes in all.
choices.C: The store's profit was $6 on each shirt and $4 on each hat, $360 in all.
choices.D: If every price had been 20% higher, the total would have been $1,080.

questions.subskill: Recovering concentrations from two trial mixtures
questions.stem: Solution A and solution B each contain acid at a fixed percent by volume. A mixture of equal volumes of A and B is 30% acid, and a mixture of 1 liter of A with 2 liters of B is 25% acid. How many liters of solution A are in 12 liters of a mixture of A and B that is 40% acid?

questions.subskill: Original price from two discounts
questions.stem: A store offers two discounts on a jacket. With a p% discount, the jacket costs $33.60. With a (p + 10)% discount, it costs $28.80. What is the original price of the jacket, in dollars?

questions.subskill: Greatest value under a sum cap and a difference condition
questions.stem: An airline allows each passenger two checked bags with a combined weight of at most 50 kilograms. Lena's heavier bag weighs at least 8 kilograms more than her lighter bag. What is the greatest possible weight, in kilograms, of her lighter bag?

questions.subskill: Solution that does not depend on the parameter
questions.stem: In the equation cx + 12 = 3x + 4c, c is a constant. If the equation has exactly one solution, what is that solution?

questions.subskill: Sum of outputs of a linear function
questions.stem: For the linear function f, f(3) = 10 and f(9) = 28. What is the value of f(1) + f(2) + f(3) + … + f(11) ?

questions.subskill: Difference in predictions with a unit change
questions.stem: A scatterplot shows the population x, in thousands, and the number of hospitals y for each of 40 cities. The line of best fit is y = 0.035x + 2.1. According to the line of best fit, how many more hospitals are predicted for a city that has 1.2 million more people than another city?

questions.subskill: Choosing a model with unequal spacing
questions.stem: A scientist recorded six data points (x, y): (0, 12.0), (1, 14.6), (3, 19.9), (4, 22.4), (6, 27.8), and (7, 30.5). Which type of model best fits the data, and why?

choices.A: An exponential model, because y increases by roughly 20% from each row of the table to the next
choices.B: Neither a linear nor an exponential model, because the increases in y alternate between about 2.6 and about 5.3
choices.C: A linear model, because y increases by about 3.7 for each increase of 1 in x
choices.D: A linear model, because y increases by about 2.6 for each increase of 1 in x

questions.subskill: Median of two combined frequency tables
questions.stem: Two classes took the same 5-point quiz. In class 1 (20 students), the numbers of students who scored 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 points were 6, 5, 2, 3, and 4, respectively. In class 2 (24 students), the numbers who scored 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 points were 1, 3, 3, 4, and 13, respectively. What is the median score of all 44 students?

questions.subskill: Hidden water in an ingredient
questions.stem: A bread dough is made from only flour and water, mixed in the ratio 5 : 3 by mass. The flour itself is 12% water by mass. What percent of the dough's mass is water? (Disregard the % sign when entering your answer. For example, if your answer is 42.1%, enter 42.1)

questions.subskill: Conditional probability with a computed rate condition
questions.stem:
The table lists 8 apartments by number of bedrooms, monthly rent, and floor area.
1 bedroom, $1,350, 600 square feet
1 bedroom, $1,200, 650 square feet
1 bedroom, $1,420, 720 square feet
1 bedroom, $1,100, 580 square feet
2 bedrooms, $1,800, 950 square feet
2 bedrooms, $2,100, 1,000 square feet
2 bedrooms, $1,950, 1,050 square feet
2 bedrooms, $2,000, 980 square feet
An apartment whose monthly rent is less than $2.00 per square foot will be selected at random. What is the probability that it has 2 bedrooms?

questions.subskill: Average rate from cumulative totals at unequal times
questions.stem: A pump empties a flooded basement. The total volume of water pumped out t minutes after the pump starts is 0 liters at t = 0, 90 liters at t = 5, 300 liters at t = 20, 420 liters at t = 30, and 600 liters at t = 45. During which interval was the average pumping rate greatest?

questions.subskill: Buying unused tickets to reach a group price
questions.stem: A theater sells tickets for $15 each, but a group that buys at least 12 tickets pays $11 per ticket. A group of n people, where n < 12, wants to see a show. What is the least value of n for which the group pays less by buying 12 tickets at the group price (and leaving the extra tickets unused) than by buying n tickets at the regular price?

questions.subskill: System from two changes in group size
questions.stem: A group of friends will share the total cost of renting a cabin equally. If 2 more friends joined the group and the total cost stayed the same, each person's share would be $30 less. If instead 1 friend left the group, each person's share would be $30 more. What is the total cost, in dollars, of renting the cabin?

questions.subskill: Bounding the error of an approximation
questions.stem: A traveler converts a temperature C, in degrees Celsius, to degrees Fahrenheit with the shortcut 2C + 30 instead of the exact formula 1.8C + 32. For which values of C does the shortcut differ from the exact Fahrenheit temperature by at most 2 degrees?

questions.subskill: Linear function from values given in terms of a parameter
questions.stem: For the linear function f, f(a) = 2a and f(2a) = 3a, where a is a nonzero constant. Which of the following is equal to f(5a) ?

questions.subskill: Required share of remaining votes
questions.stem: In an election, 5,000 votes have been counted so far, and candidate R has received 46% of them. Exactly 2,000 votes remain to be counted. What percent of the remaining votes must candidate R receive to finish with at least 52% of all the votes? (Disregard the % sign when entering your answer. For example, if your answer is 42.1%, enter 42.1)

questions.subskill: Median from the sum of the middle pair
questions.stem: A data set consists of 10 numbers, and its mean is 18. The mean of the 4 smallest numbers is 10, and the mean of the 4 largest numbers is 27. What is the median of the data set?

questions.subskill: Self-selection after random assignment
questions.stem: A company randomly assigned 200 employees who volunteered for a study to two groups of 100. Group 1 was asked to use a focus-training app for 8 weeks, and group 2 did not use the app. Only 55 of the employees in group 1 used the app for all 8 weeks. The researchers compared the mean change in productivity of these 55 employees with the mean change of all 100 employees in group 2 and found that the 55 improved significantly more. Which statement best explains why this comparison does not show that using the app causes greater improvement?

choices.A: The 55 finishers chose to stay, so they may differ in ways, like motivation, that affect productivity.
choices.B: The employees were volunteers rather than a random sample drawn from all of the company's employees.
choices.C: The two groups being compared contain different numbers of employees, 55 and 100.
choices.D: The study did not give the employees in group 2 a placebo app to use.

questions.subskill: Flow rate in containers per minute
questions.stem: A river carries water past a gauge at an average rate of 1,200 cubic meters per second. An Olympic-size swimming pool holds about 2,500 cubic meters of water. At this rate, about how many pools' worth of water pass the gauge each minute?

questions.subskill: Speeds from a meeting point
questions.stem: Towns A and B are 30 kilometers apart on a straight road. Two cyclists start at the same time, one from each town, and ride toward each other at different constant speeds. They meet 18 kilometers from town A. After they meet, the cyclist who started from town A takes 1.2 hours to reach town B. How many hours after the meeting does the other cyclist reach town A?

questions.subskill: Chained percents with different bases
questions.stem: A phone battery's capacity was 4,000 milliampere-hours (mAh) when new. The phone reports a battery health of 85%, which means the battery now holds 85% of its original capacity. The phone shows a charge of 40%, which is 40% of the battery's current capacity. If video playback uses 400 mAh per hour, about how many hours of video can the phone play before the battery is empty?

questions.subskill: Solving a formula with a radical for a variable
questions.stem: The period T, in seconds, of a simple pendulum of length L meters is given by T = 2π√(L/g), where g is the acceleration due to gravity, in meters per second squared. Which of the following expresses L in terms of T and g?

questions.subskill: Quadratic from trimming two sides of a rectangle
questions.stem: A rectangular poster is 30 inches long and 20 inches wide. A strip of uniform width x inches is trimmed from one long side and another strip of the same width is trimmed from one short side, so that both the length and the width of the poster decrease by x inches. The trimmed poster has an area of 336 square inches. What is the value of x?

questions.subskill: Composing a rational function with itself
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = 1/(1 − x). For x ≠ 0 and x ≠ 1, which of the following is equivalent to f(f(x))?

questions.subskill: Slope between the vertex and the y-intercept of a parabola
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, the graph of y = x² + bx + c, where b and c are constants and b ≠ 0, is a parabola. The line that passes through the vertex of the parabola and through the y-intercept of the parabola has a slope of −3. What is the value of b?

questions.subskill: Quadratic inequality at a nonzero threshold
questions.stem: The graph of the quadratic function f in the xy-plane has x-intercepts at x = −1 and x = 5 and a y-intercept at y = −5. The solutions to the inequality f(x) < −5 are all values of x such that p < x < q, where p and q are constants. What is the value of q?

questions.subskill: Quadratic whose coefficients are its own roots
questions.stem: In the equation x² + bx + c = 0, b and c are nonzero constants and b ≠ c. The two solutions of the equation are b and c. What is the value of c?

questions.subskill: Discriminant as a quadratic in a parameter
questions.stem: In the equation x² + kx + k + 3 = 0, k is a constant. Which of the following describes all values of k for which the equation has no real solutions?

questions.subskill: Three mutually tangent circles forming a right triangle
questions.stem: Three circles are each tangent to the other two, and no circle lies inside another. Their radii are 1, 2, and r, where r > 2. The centers of the three circles are the vertices of a right triangle. What is the value of r?

questions.subskill: Interior diagonal of a box from its face diagonals
questions.stem: The diagonals of the three faces of a rectangular box that meet at one corner have lengths √13, √40, and √45 centimeters. What is the length, in centimeters, of a diagonal of the box that goes through its interior from one corner to the opposite corner?

questions.subskill: Right triangle with sides in arithmetic sequence
questions.stem: The side lengths of a right triangle form an arithmetic sequence, and the area of the triangle is 54 square units. What is the perimeter of the triangle, in units?

questions.subskill: Inscribed right angle and a 30-60-90 triangle
questions.stem: Segment AB is a diameter of a circle, and point C lies on the circle. The measure of angle CAB is 30°, and the area of triangle ABC is 18√3. What is the radius of the circle?

questions.subskill: Cylinder inscribed in a cone
questions.stem: A right circular cone has a base radius of 6 centimeters and a height of 12 centimeters. A right circular cylinder whose height is equal to its diameter sits inside the cone, with its bottom base on the cone's base and the circular edge of its top base touching the cone's lateral surface. The volume of the cylinder is kπ cubic centimeters. What is the value of k?

questions.subskill: Solving a counting quadratic for the number of teams
questions.stem: In a league, each team plays every other team exactly once. If the league has n teams, the number of games played is n(n − 1)/2. In one season, 78 games were played. How many teams are in the league?

questions.subskill: Combining exponential factors with different bases
questions.stem: If 2^(x + 1) · 3^(x − 1) = 16, what is the value of 6ˣ?

questions.subskill: Homogeneous quadratic in two variables
questions.stem: If x² − 5xy + 6y² = 0, where y ≠ 0 and x ≠ 2y, what is the value of x/y?

questions.subskill: Recovering a half-life from a fraction remaining
questions.stem: A sample of a radioactive substance decays so that the amount remaining is halved every h hours. After 10 hours, 1/32 of the original amount remains. What is the value of h?

questions.subskill: Areas of semicircles on collinear diameters
questions.stem: Point C lies on segment AB, where AB = 12 and AC = 4. Semicircles are drawn on the same side of line AB with diameters AB, AC, and CB. What is the area of the region that is inside the semicircle with diameter AB but outside the other two semicircles?

questions.subskill: Volume scaling of similar solids
questions.stem: A solid metal sphere with a radius of 6 centimeters is melted down, and all of the metal is used to make solid spheres that each have a radius of 2 centimeters. How many of the smaller spheres are made?

questions.subskill: Regular polygons meeting at a point
questions.stem: An equilateral triangle, a regular decagon (10 sides), and a regular polygon with n sides fit together around a point, each with one vertex at the point, so that they cover the region around the point with no gaps or overlaps. What is the value of n?

questions.subskill: Trigonometric ratio through similar triangles
questions.stem: Right triangles PQR and STU are similar, with vertices P, Q, and R corresponding to S, T, and U, respectively. Angles R and U are right angles, PR = 24, and QR = 7. What is the value of cos T?

questions.subskill: Square inscribed in a square off the midpoints
questions.stem: Square EFGH lies inside square ABCD, with E on side AB, F on side BC, G on side CD, and H on side DA. AE = 6, and the area of square EFGH is 100. What is the side length of square ABCD?

questions.subskill: Circle through three points with a right angle
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, a circle passes through the points (1, 2), (13, 2), and (1, 7). What is the radius of the circle?

questions.subskill: Segment through the intersection of trapezoid diagonals
questions.stem: In trapezoid ABCD, side AB is parallel to side CD, AB = 15, and CD = 10. The diagonals AC and BD intersect at point P. A segment through P parallel to AB has one endpoint on leg AD and the other on leg BC. What is the length of this segment?

questions.subskill: Ladder positions given by a sine and a cosine
questions.stem: A 17-foot ladder leans against a vertical wall, with its base on level ground. At first, the ladder makes an angle of x° with the ground, where sin x° = 8/17. The base of the ladder is then moved toward the wall until the ladder makes an angle of y° with the ground, where cos y° = 8/17. How many feet higher up the wall does the top of the ladder reach after the move?

questions.subskill: Linear growth from block totals
questions.stem: A company's annual revenue increased by the same amount each year from 2020 through 2026. The company's total revenue for the three years 2020, 2021, and 2022 was $45 million, and its total revenue for the three years 2023, 2024, and 2025 was $63 million. What was the company's revenue, in millions of dollars, in 2026?

questions.subskill: Splitting a combined rate using a difference
questions.stem: Ana and Ben start 1,500 meters apart and walk toward each other along a straight path, each at a constant speed. The distance between them, in meters, t minutes after they start is D = 1,500 − 150t. Ana walks 30 meters per minute faster than Ben. How many meters will Ben have walked when they meet?

questions.subskill: Count-and-total system with different billing periods
questions.stem: A gym has 300 members. Each member either pays $40 per month or pays $360 per year. In one year, the gym collected a total of $117,600 from these 300 members, and every member who pays by the month paid for all 12 months. How many members pay $360 per year?

questions.subskill: Percent change under constant dollar growth
questions.stem: Ana's annual salary increased by the same dollar amount each year from 2018 to 2026. Her salary in 2022 was 25% greater than her salary in 2018. By what percent was her salary in 2026 greater than her salary in 2022?

questions.subskill: Ratio of actual values around an exponential fit
questions.stem: A scatterplot shows the number of subscribers y, in thousands, to a newsletter x months after it was launched, for x = 0 to x = 12. An exponential curve of best fit for the data is y = 3.2(1.3)^x. The actual number of subscribers at x = 6 was 10% less than the number predicted by the curve, and the actual number at x = 7 was 10% greater than the number predicted by the curve. The actual number of subscribers at x = 7 was approximately what percent greater than the actual number at x = 6? Round your answer to the nearest whole percent. (Disregard the % sign when entering your answer.)

questions.subskill: Combining two studies with different kinds of randomness
questions.stem: Two studies looked at volunteer work and life satisfaction. In study 1, researchers selected 600 adults at random from all the adults in a city; adults who reported more hours of volunteer work tended to report higher life satisfaction. In study 2, 200 adults who answered an advertisement were randomly assigned either to volunteer 2 hours each week for 3 months or not to volunteer; at the end, the volunteer group reported higher average life satisfaction, and the difference was too large to be explained by chance. Which conclusion is best supported by the two studies?

choices.A: Volunteering likely causes higher satisfaction for the city's adults, since study 1 sampled the city at random and study 2 assigned volunteering at random.
choices.B: Volunteering likely causes higher satisfaction for adults like those in study 2, and study 1's association can be generalized to the city's adults.
choices.C: Neither study supports a cause-and-effect conclusion, because the adults in study 2 were not selected at random from the city.
choices.D: Study 1 shows that volunteering causes higher satisfaction for the city's adults, and study 2 shows only an association for its volunteers.

questions.subskill: Mixing paints given by part-to-part ratios
questions.stem: Paint A is a mixture of blue paint and white paint in the ratio 1 : 3 by volume, and paint B is a mixture of blue paint and white paint in the ratio 2 : 3 by volume. A painter mixes 1 liter of paint A with 2 liters of paint B. What fraction of the resulting 3 liters of paint, by volume, is blue paint?

questions.subskill: Unit cost built from usage per batch
questions.stem: An ink cartridge holds 12 milliliters of ink and costs $30. Printing 50 pages of a typical document uses 0.8 milliliter of ink. At this rate, what is the cost of the ink, in cents, for each page?

questions.subskill: Shifting values above and below the median
questions.stem: A data set consists of 11 different numbers, and its median is 20. Each number in the data set that is greater than 20 is increased by 5, and each number that is less than 20 is decreased by 5. Compared with the original data set, which of the following must be true of the new data set?

choices.A: The mean is the same, and the range is the same.
choices.B: The mean is 5 greater, and the range is 10 greater.
choices.C: The mean is 5 greater, and the range is the same.
choices.D: The mean is the same, and the range is 10 greater.

questions.subskill: Prediction from a line through two points
questions.stem: A scatterplot shows the height y, in centimeters, of each of 14 bean seedlings and the number of days x since the seedling sprouted. The line of best fit passes through the points (0, 4.2) and (10, 9.2). According to the line of best fit, what is the predicted height, in centimeters, of a seedling 16 days after it sprouted?

questions.subskill: Difference of a two-input linear cost for any value
questions.stem: A car rental company charges C = 25d + 0.15m dollars to rent a car for d days and drive it m miles. Trip A is a 3-day rental in which the car is driven m miles, and trip B is a 2-day rental in which the car is driven m + 100 miles. Which of the following statements is true?

choices.A: Trip B costs $10 more than trip A.
choices.B: Trip B costs $15 more than trip A.
choices.C: Which trip costs more depends on the value of m.
choices.D: Trip A costs $10 more than trip B.

questions.subskill: Expression as a multiple of a given linear form
questions.stem: If 6x − 4y = 18, what is the value of y − 1.5x?

questions.subskill: Interpreting a difference of function values
questions.stem: The depth of snow on a roof, in centimeters, t hours after it stops snowing is modeled by S(t) = 30 − 1.5t. Which of the following is the best interpretation of S(t) − S(t + 3) in this context?

choices.A: The snow depth, in centimeters, 3 hours after it stops snowing
choices.B: The decrease in snow depth, in centimeters, during any 3-hour period
choices.C: The decrease in snow depth, in centimeters, during each hour
choices.D: The number of hours it takes for the snow depth to decrease by 3 centimeters

questions.subskill: Conditions on two constants from a solution point
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, the point (4, 3) is a solution to the system of inequalities y < ax − 5 and y > b − 2x, where a and b are constants. Which of the following must be true?

questions.subskill: Interpreting the base of an exponential fit with a decade unit
questions.stem: A scatterplot shows the population y, in millions, of a country x decades after 1950, for x = 0 to x = 7. An exponential curve of best fit for the data is y = 2.1(1.4)^x. Which of the following is the best interpretation of 1.4 in this context?

choices.A: The predicted population increases by 40% each year.
choices.B: The predicted population increases by 1.4 million each decade.
choices.C: The predicted population increases by 40% each decade.
choices.D: The predicted population increases by 1.4 million each year.

questions.subskill: Recovering a sample count from an interval
questions.stem: A news report, based on a random sample of 1,200 adults in a state, says that between 38% and 44% of the state's adults carpool to work. This range is the sample percent plus or minus the margin of error. How many adults in the sample said they carpool to work?

questions.subskill: Diagnosing a causal claim from random selection
questions.stem: A researcher selected 300 of a university's 9,000 students at random. Of these 300 students, 120 had chosen to attend a free study-skills workshop, and their mean grade point average (GPA) the next term was higher than that of the other 180 students. The researcher claims, "Because the students were selected at random, these results show that the workshop caused higher GPAs among the university's students." Which statement best explains why this claim is not justified?

choices.A: Students chose whether to attend, so the groups may differ in other ways; random selection does not make the workshop the cause.
choices.B: A sample of 300 students is too small to support any conclusion about all 9,000 students, even with random selection.
choices.C: Because the students were selected at random, the results apply only to the 300 selected students and not to the university.
choices.D: The two groups had different numbers of students, 120 and 180, so their mean GPAs cannot be compared fairly.

questions.subskill: Percentage points versus percent change
questions.stem: From 2020 to 2024, the percent of the households in a town that had solar panels increased from 8% to 10%. Which statement correctly describes this change?

choices.A: It increased by 2 percent, which is an increase of 25 percentage points.
choices.B: It increased by 2 percentage points, which is an increase of 25 percent.
choices.C: It increased by 2 percentage points, which is an increase of 20 percent.
choices.D: It increased by 2 percent, which is an increase of 20 percentage points.

questions.subskill: Median after adding a value that keeps the mean
questions.stem: The data set 2, 3, 4, 5, 20, 26 consists of six numbers. A seventh number is added to the data set, and the mean of the data set does not change. What is the median of the new data set of seven numbers?

questions.subskill: Conditional probability from a two-way table
questions.stem: The table shows all 60 tiles in a bag, by color and shape: red squares, 12; red circles, 18; blue squares, 20; blue circles, 10. If a blue tile is selected at random from the bag, what is the probability that it is a circle?

questions.subskill: What a margin of error does and does not guarantee
questions.stem: A random sample of 500 of a city's 80,000 adults were asked whether they had used the public library in the past year, and 62% of the sample said yes. The margin of error for this estimate is 4 percentage points. Which of the following must be true?

choices.A: Between 58% and 66% of the city's adults used the public library in the past year.
choices.B: At least 46,400 of the city's adults used the public library in the past year.
choices.C: Exactly 310 adults in another random sample of 500 from the city would say yes.
choices.D: Exactly 310 of the 500 adults in the sample said they had used the library.

questions.subskill: Reducing a cubic with a quadratic relation
questions.stem: If x² = 2x + 1, what is the value of x³ − 5x?

questions.subskill: Quadratic from coefficient sums
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = ax² + bx + c, where a, b, and c are constants. If a + b + c = 0, 9a + 3b + c = 0, and c = 6, what is the minimum value of f(x)?

questions.subskill: Sum of two rational expressions that cancel
questions.stem: For x ≠ −2 and x ≠ 3, which of the following is equivalent to (x² + 5x + 6)/(x + 2) + (x² − 9)/(3 − x)?

questions.subskill: Odd part plus a constant
questions.stem: The function p is defined by p(x) = x³ − 4x + 2. If p(a) = 9, what is the value of p(−a)?

questions.subskill: Comparing average rates of change of an exponential
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = 3 · 2ˣ. The average rate of change of f from x = 1 to x = 3 is how many times the average rate of change of f from x = 0 to x = 2?

questions.subskill: Area between two sectors with a shared angle
questions.stem: Two circles have the same center O, with radii 4 and 6. Two radii of the larger circle form a central angle of θ radians, and the part of the region between the two circles that lies inside this angle has an area of 5π. What is the value of θ?

questions.subskill: Inscribed triangle from an arc ratio
questions.stem: Triangle ABC is inscribed in a circle with radius 5. Its vertices divide the circle into three arcs whose lengths are in the ratio 1 : 2 : 3. What is the area of triangle ABC?

questions.subskill: Distance condition with the unknown in both points
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, the distance between the points (k, 3) and (2, k) is 5. What is the greatest possible value of k?

questions.subskill: Right-triangle area from a product of trigonometric ratios
questions.stem: In right triangle ABC, angle C is the right angle and AB = 12. If sin A · cos A = 0.4, what is the area of triangle ABC?

questions.subskill: Equal segments inside a right triangle
questions.stem: In right triangle ABC, angle C is the right angle, AC = 8, and tan A = 3/4. Point D lies on side AC so that BD = AD. What is the length of CD?

questions.subskill: Required speed for a target average
questions.stem: Kim is driving 120 miles. She drove the first 30 miles at an average speed of 45 miles per hour. What is the least average speed, in miles per hour, at which she can drive the remaining 90 miles so that her average speed for the whole trip is at least 60 miles per hour?

questions.subskill: Difference of a function at shifted inputs
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = 3x² − 2. Which of the following is equivalent to f(x + h) − f(x)?

questions.subskill: Substituting a linear expression into a quadratic
questions.stem: If x = 2t − 1, which of the following is equivalent to x² + 2x in terms of t?

questions.subskill: Regrouping a four-factor product
questions.stem: If x² + 4x = 6, what is the value of x(x + 1)(x + 3)(x + 4)?

questions.subskill: Parameter that makes a point a hole
questions.stem: The expression (x² − k²)/(x − k), where k is a constant, has a value of 10 when x = 4. What is the value of k?

questions.subskill: Where a parabola is negative and falling
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = (x − 1)(x − 5). For which of the following intervals is the graph of y = f(x) in the xy-plane both below the x-axis and falling from left to right?

questions.subskill: Sum of fixed points of a rational function
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = (x + 1)/(x − 3). What is the sum of all values of a for which f(a) = a?

questions.subskill: Median to the hypotenuse
questions.stem: In right triangle ABC, angle C is the right angle, AC = 8, and BC = 15. Point M is the midpoint of hypotenuse AB. What is the length of segment CM?

questions.subskill: Square vertex from opposite vertices
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, the points (1, 2) and (7, 6) are opposite vertices of a square. Which of the following is another vertex of the square?

questions.subskill: Meaning of a radian
questions.stem: An arc of a circle has the same length as the diameter of the circle. What is the measure, in radians, of the central angle that intercepts the arc?

questions.subskill: Surface area of a half cylinder
questions.stem: A solid right circular cylinder has a radius of 3 centimeters and a height of 10 centimeters. It is cut into two congruent pieces by a plane that contains the axis of the cylinder. What is the total surface area, in square centimeters, of one of the pieces?

questions.subskill: Trigonometric ratio via parallel lines
questions.stem: Square ABCD has sides of length 8, with its vertices in the order A, B, C, D. Point E lies on side BC so that BE = 6. What is the value of sin(∠DAE)?

questions.subskill: Volume after removing a corner pyramid
questions.stem: A wooden cube has edges of length 6 centimeters. One corner is sawed off by a single flat cut that passes through the three vertices of the cube that share an edge with that corner. What is the volume, in cubic centimeters, of the larger remaining piece?

questions.subskill: Intercept of a line translated in two directions
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, the graph of 4x − 3y = 24 is translated 2 units to the right and 3 units up. What is the y-coordinate of the y-intercept of the translated graph?

questions.subskill: Points equidistant from both axes on a line
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, point P lies on the line y = 2x − 6, and P is the same distance from the x-axis as it is from the y-axis. What is the sum of all possible x-coordinates of P?

questions.subskill: System with a parameter and an extra condition
questions.stem: In the system of equations 3x − 2y = k and x + 4y = 2k, k is a constant. If (x, y) is the solution of the system and x + y = 13, what is the value of k?

questions.subskill: Which of two constraints binds
questions.stem: A bakery makes x loaves of bread and y cakes each day. Each loaf needs 2 minutes of oven time and 3 cups of flour, and each cake needs 5 minutes of oven time and 2 cups of flour. The bakery has at most 100 minutes of oven time and at most 75 cups of flour each day, so 2x + 5y ≤ 100 and 3x + 2y ≤ 75. If the bakery makes 12 cakes on a certain day, what is the greatest number of loaves it can make that day?

questions.subskill: Point on a transformed graph to a point on f
questions.stem: The function f is linear. In the xy-plane, the graph of y = f(x) passes through the point (2, 5), and the graph of y = f(2x) passes through the point (3, 11). What is the value of f(0)?

questions.subskill: Intersection of two linear functions from a table
questions.stem: The functions f and g are linear. The table gives some values of f(x) and g(x): for x = 2, f(x) = 10 and g(x) = 4; for x = 6, f(x) = 18 and g(x) = 20. In the xy-plane, the graphs of y = f(x) and y = g(x) intersect at the point (p, q). What is the value of q?

questions.subskill: When two conditional probabilities are equal
questions.stem: Each of 200 students at a school is in exactly one grade and exactly one music ensemble. The table shows the numbers of students. Grade 10: band 14, choir 22, orchestra 12. Grade 11: band 26, choir 18, orchestra 16. Grade 12: band 20, choir 30, orchestra 42. For which grade and ensemble is the probability that a randomly chosen student in that grade is in that ensemble equal to the probability that a randomly chosen member of that ensemble is in that grade?

questions.subskill: Which statistics an open top category leaves undetermined
questions.stem:
In a survey of 50 households, each household reported its number of children. The results are 12 households with 0 children, 15 with 1 child, 11 with 2 children, 7 with 3 children, and 5 with "4 or more" children. Which of the following can be determined from these results?
I. The median number of children per household
II. The mean number of children per household
III. The mode of the number of children per household

questions.subskill: Combining two groups with different ratios
questions.stem: Class A has 30 students, and the ratio of girls to boys in class A is 3 to 2. Class B has 24 students, and the ratio of girls to boys in class B is 1 to 2. The two classes are combined for a field trip. What is the ratio of girls to boys in the combined group?

questions.subskill: Recovering a whole from a percent and comparing
questions.stem: One serving of a snack contains 12 grams of fat, which is 15% of the recommended daily value of fat. A bag of the snack contains 2.5 servings. If a person eats the entire bag, how many more grams of fat would the person need to eat to reach exactly the recommended daily value?

questions.subskill: Converting a mixed-unit notation
questions.stem: The height of a horse is measured in hands, where 1 hand = 4 inches. Heights are written as hands followed by a period and the number of extra inches, so a height written as 15.2 hands means 15 hands plus 2 inches. How many inches taller is a horse whose height is written as 16.1 hands than a horse whose height is written as 15.3 hands?

questions.subskill: Recovering rates from a piecewise tank process
questions.stem: A tank initially holds 50 liters of water. Valve A, which adds water at a constant rate, is opened at time t = 0. At t = 4 minutes the tank holds 110 liters, and at that moment drain B, which removes water at a constant rate, is also opened, with valve A still open. At t = 10 minutes the tank holds 140 liters, and valve A is closed while drain B stays open. At what time t, in minutes, will the tank be empty?

questions.subskill: Translating a verbal relation between two outputs
questions.stem: A kayak rental shop charges a flat fee plus the same amount for each hour of rental. Renting a kayak for 3 hours costs $5 more than twice the cost of renting a kayak for 1 hour, and renting a kayak for 4 hours costs $70. What is the charge, in dollars, for each hour of rental?

questions.subskill: Vertical change from a slope and a run
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, a line with slope −2/5 passes through the points (a, b) and (a + 10, b + k), where a, b, and k are constants. What is the value of k?

questions.subskill: Range of slopes for lines meeting a segment
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, segment AB has endpoints A(2, 8) and B(10, 2). For which values of the constant m does the line y = mx intersect segment AB?

questions.subskill: Systematic sampling aligned with a production cycle
questions.stem: A factory has four machines, A, B, C, and D, that place finished items on a single conveyor belt in the repeating order A, B, C, D, A, B, C, D, and so on, starting with machine A. To estimate the percent of the factory's items that are defective, an inspector checks every 8th item on the belt (the 8th item, the 16th item, the 24th item, and so on) during one day. Which statement about this method is true?

choices.A: Every inspected item comes from machine D, so the estimate may not reflect all four machines.
choices.B: It would likely give an unbiased estimate if the inspector checked every 4th item instead.
choices.C: It likely gives an unbiased estimate, since every item has the same 1-in-8 chance of inspection.
choices.D: It may be biased, but only because fewer than half of that day's items are inspected.

questions.subskill: Interpreting an x-intercept outside the data range
questions.stem: A scatterplot shows the high temperature x, in degrees Fahrenheit, and the number of iced drinks y sold at a café on each of 30 summer days. The high temperatures in the data range from 58°F to 96°F. The line of best fit is y = 4.2x − 96, and its x-intercept is at x ≈ 22.9. Which is the best interpretation of the x-intercept?

choices.A: The café sold no iced drinks on a day with a high of about 22.9°F, a temperature within the data's range.
choices.B: The café sold no iced drinks on a day with a high of about 22.9°F, a temperature far below the data.
choices.C: The model predicts 0 iced drinks at about 22.9°F, a temperature within the data's range.
choices.D: The model predicts 0 iced drinks at about 22.9°F, a temperature far below the data.

questions.subskill: Comparing percent increases across groups
questions.stem: The table shows the number of members in four school clubs in 2022 and in 2024. Chess: 30 in 2022, 39 in 2024. Drama: 75 in 2022, 93 in 2024. Robotics: 24 in 2022, 33 in 2024. Debate: 120 in 2022, 141 in 2024. Which club had the greatest percent increase in membership from 2022 to 2024?

questions.subskill: Effect on mean and median of removing the median
questions.stem: A data set consists of 9 numbers. The mean of the data set is 50, and the median is 48. The number 48 is removed from the data set. Which of the following correctly describes the 8 remaining numbers?

choices.A: The mean is 50, and the median is 48.
choices.B: The mean is 50.25, and the median cannot be determined from the given information.
choices.C: The mean is 50.25, and the median is 48.
choices.D: The mean is 50, and the median cannot be determined from the given information.

questions.subskill: Share of a combined total from per-person rates
questions.stem: City A has a population of 100,000 and recycles an average of 0.8 kilogram of material per person per day. City B has a population of 150,000 and recycles an average of 0.3 kilogram per person per day. Of the total amount of material the two cities recycle per day, what percent is recycled by City A? (Disregard the % sign when entering your answer.)

questions.subskill: Applying a common sampling fraction
questions.stem: A researcher selected a sample of students from three grades so that the same fraction of each grade's students was selected. Grade 9 has 340 students, and 18 grade 9 students were selected. 27 grade 10 students were selected. Grade 11 has 850 students. How many students in all were selected from the three grades?

questions.subskill: Line through a point with a given triangle area
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, line ℓ has a negative slope and passes through the point (2, 6). Line ℓ and the two coordinate axes form a triangle with an area of 25 square units. What is the greatest possible y-intercept of line ℓ?

questions.subskill: Swapped coordinates on two different lines
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, the point (a, b) lies on the line y = 2x + 1, and the point (b, a) lies on the line y = 3x − 13, where a and b are constants. What is the value of b?

questions.subskill: Power of a power as a difference of squares
questions.stem: For x > 1, (x^(a + b))^(a − b) = x⁴⁵ and xᵃ/xᵇ = x³, where a and b are constants. What is the value of a + b?

questions.subskill: Rational equation from reciprocals of two numbers
questions.stem: Two positive numbers differ by 2, and the sum of their reciprocals is 5/12. What is the greater of the two numbers?

questions.subskill: Exponential with an added constant from three values
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = a · bˣ + c, where a, b, and c are constants and b > 0. If f(0) = 5, f(1) = 11, and f(2) = 29, what is the value of f(3)?

questions.subskill: Recovering a list size from a mean change
questions.stem: A list of numbers has a mean of 30. When the number 50 is added to the list, the mean of the new list is 32. If, instead, the number 6 had been added to the original list, what would the mean of the new list have been?

questions.subskill: Group share from a weighted average
questions.stem: At a school, 65% of the students who took an exam passed it. Of the students who took the exam and attended a review session, 80% passed; of the students who took the exam and did not attend the review session, 30% passed. What percent of the students who took the exam attended the review session?

questions.subskill: Circle from two points and a line through its center
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, a circle passes through the points (1, 7) and (5, 3), and its center lies on the line y = 2x. An equation of the circle is (x − h)² + (y − k)² = r², where h, k, and r are constants. What is the value of r²?

questions.subskill: Effect of a capped shift on mean and median
questions.stem: On a 100-point test, the 25 students in a class had scores with a median of 76, and exactly 4 students scored above 90. The teacher raised every student's score by 10 points, except that any score that would go above 100 was set to 100 instead. Which of the following must be true about the new scores compared with the original scores?

choices.A: The median increased by exactly 10 points, and the mean increased by less than 10 points.
choices.B: Both the median and the mean increased by exactly 10 points.
choices.C: The mean increased by exactly 10 points, and the median increased by less than 10 points.
choices.D: Both the median and the mean increased by less than 10 points.

questions.subskill: Missing comparison group in outcome-selected data
questions.stem: A school counselor wanted to know whether students who attend the school's after-school tutoring program are more likely to earn an A in algebra than students who do not attend. She looked at the records of the 50 students who earned an A in algebra last year and found that 40 of them, or 80%, had attended the tutoring program. Which additional information is most needed to answer the counselor's question?

choices.A: The percent of the students in the school's geometry classes who earned an A last year
choices.B: The percent of the students who did not earn an A in algebra who attended the tutoring program
choices.C: The total number of students at the school who attended the tutoring program last year
choices.D: The percent of the 50 students who earned an A who said the tutoring program was helpful
